modules.name: Reports and Activity Log
modules.description: Dashboards, reports and a log of user actions for Raghuvir Admin and Society Managers.

requirements.title: Admin dashboard
requirements.description: On web, the Raghuvir Admin sees complaints by project, category, status and delays, and approved residents vs flats. Priority is Must.

requirements.title: Reports by date range
requirements.description: On web, for a chosen date range, reports show closure time, delays, reopen count and top categories. Priority is Must.

requirements.title: Society Manager summary
requirements.description: On mobile, a Society Manager sees a summary of their own project. Priority is Should.

requirements.title: Activity log
requirements.description: On web, any approval, rejection, status change, role change or delete is recorded in an activity log. Priority is Must.

rules.title: Society Manager sees own project only
rules.description: A Society Manager's summary shows only the summary of their own project.

rules.title: Log user and time for changes
rules.description: For any approval, rejection, status or role change, or delete, the user and the time must be saved.
